challenge.scenario: A legacy producer inserts support_reply with officeThreadId referencing a different tenant.
challenge.finding: Cross-instance mail could be sent to an unrelated customer conversation.
challenge.resolution: Check thread where id and instance_id match job instance and conversation_type customer.

challenge.scenario: An attacker inserts malformed officeThreadId UUID in support_reply payload.
challenge.finding: Invalid UUID may escape validation or create job without associated thread.
challenge.resolution: Canonical exception block must raise OFFICE_REPLY_THREAD_REQUIRED on cast failure.

challenge.scenario: A customer thread has no configured mailbox_key when an outbound reply is queued.
challenge.finding: Reply from-address is undefined and privacy route cannot be ensured.

challenge.scenario: A mailbox exists but has is_active=false.
challenge.finding: Sending would use an inactive/unverified inbound-outbound identity.
challenge.resolution: Verify active mailbox is required in same instance with matching mailbox_key.

challenge.scenario: No office_thread_email_routes entry exists for the candidate customer thread.
challenge.finding: Reply path would be untraceable to private token routing, risking loss/misdelivery.
challenge.resolution: Guard must raise OFFICE_EMAIL_ROUTE_MISSING before inserting queue job.

challenge.scenario: An unrelated non-support or untagged communication job is inserted.
challenge.finding: Overly broad trigger blocks transactional mail that is not Office reply.
challenge.resolution: Early-return unless template_key support_reply and payload has officeThreadId.

challenge.scenario: A legacy job updates its Office payload after initial queue insertion.
challenge.finding: One-time INSERT-only check could be bypassed by UPDATE replacing thread identifier.
challenge.resolution: Preserve canonical before INSERT OR UPDATE OF payload, template_key and tenant boundaries.

challenge.scenario: A privileged legacy producer inserts an untagged communication job and then updates its payload to include officeThreadId and support_reply.
challenge.finding: Canonical 20260908034500 trigger runs BEFORE INSERT only. An UPDATE can bypass the active mailbox/private route prerequisite, so this source migration is not the complete queue security fix.
challenge.resolution: Preserve original source identity, assert INSERT-only trigger explicitly, record mandatory separate forward-only UPDATE guard and actual negative UPDATE test before release; keep #1186 PARTIAL.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The Fresh Install baseline through 0057 now contains original Office composer and active mailbox/secret reply routes, but lacks canonical 20260908034500 reply-queue trigger. A legacy service_role or server call path may otherwise insert a communication_jobs support_reply payload containing officeThreadId without checking that the thread is customer-only, belongs to the same instance, has a configured active mailbox, and has a secret private reply route. Append canonical trigger as 0058 in isolation, do not deliver email or execute target SQL.
